summary: Verified 3 frontend-only features on Nano Fruits Pedia (dark mode toggle + system-preference, plant photo gallery, share & print buttons). All features functioning as specified. No backend testing performed (frontend-only site).
critical_code_review_comments: ThemeToggle useEffect writes 'nfp-theme=light' on mount even when the user hasn't explicitly chosen light. This overrides the 'follow system preference' logic in index.js on subsequent visits, because localStorage becomes non-null immediately after first render. Consider only writing to localStorage on actual user toggle, or storing 'system' as a valid option.
context_for_next_testing_agent: F6 toggle: light->dark->light works; localStorage 'nfp-theme' updates correctly. F6b: fresh context with color_scheme=dark applies 'dark' class on <html>; color_scheme=light does not. F7: /tanaman/mangga gallery main image src changes when clicking gallery-thumb-1 and gallery-thumb-2. F8: share-button label 'Bagikan' copies URL to clipboard and shows sonner toast 'Tautan disalin ke clipboard!' when navigator.share is unavailable; print-button label 'Cetak' invokes window.print without errors. See minor code review note about ThemeToggle overwriting localStorage on first render, which technically breaks the 'follow system on first visit' behavior on the second page load.

verification_details.F6_toggle: PASS - initial dark=false, after 1 click dark=true (ls=dark), after 2 clicks dark=false (ls=light)
verification_details.F6b_system_preference: PASS - fresh context color_scheme=dark => html has 'dark'; color_scheme=light => no 'dark'
verification_details.F7_gallery: PASS - main image src changes on thumb-1 and thumb-2 clicks (3 distinct URLs observed)
verification_details.F8_share_print: PASS - share copied full URL to clipboard, sonner toast 'Tautan disalin ke clipboard!' visible; window.print invoked without error
